theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (W A : Set (Euclidean N)), IsOpen W → μ W ≠ ∞ → A ⊆ W → μ {x | x ∈ A ∧ ¬ Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μ (A ∩ closedBall x r) / μ (closedBall x r)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)} = 0
